name: Coinpath
tagline: A personal finance tracker for accounts, budgets and cash flow
description: Coinpath is for people who want to see where their money goes and stay within a monthly budget. It keeps accounts, transactions, budgets and recurring bills in one place, in the browser, with no sign-up.
features: Running balances per account, computed in date order, with transfers excluded from income and spending
Monthly category budgets with progress, over-budget state and limits that keep past months intact
Weekly or monthly recurring rules that post on load and catch up every missed period
Hand-built SVG spending-by-category and 12-month cash flow charts with hover values
CSV import with column mapping, date format detection and duplicate detection
CSV and JSON export, JSON restore, and a choice of 12 display currencies
engineering: All money is integer cents, parsed from digit strings without floats, and recurring catch-up steps from a stored anchor day so a rule on the 31st clamps to February and returns to the 31st.
